lines.en: Golden soaring, dancing with the wind.
Blue wings flapping, soaring in the sky.
Green wings spread, flying through the forest.
PINK wings light, like cloud spirits.
Purple soaring, a night messenger.
Red burning, flying like flames.
White elegant, flying in the snow.

lines.zh: 黄色翱翔，阳光下的快乐。
lines.en: Yellow soaring, happiness in the sun.
Black swift, a night shadow.

lines.zh: 蓝羽疾飞，疾风中的战士。
lines.en: Blue swift, a warrior in the gale.

lines.zh: 大步奔跑，爪子扬起尘土。
lines.en: It runs in long strides, claws kicking up dust.

lines.zh: 翅膀半张，稳住奔跑的身子。
lines.en: Wings half open, steadying its run.

lines.zh: 一头扎进草丛，又窜出来。
lines.en: It dives into the grass and bursts out again.
Long legs clear a fallen log.
Claws click on the stone path.
Tail feathers lift as it turns sharply.
It races along the trail.

lines.zh: 奔到河边，低头喝了一口。
lines.en: It reaches the river and dips its beak.
Perched on a branch, awaiting return.
Flying leisurely, a sky wanderer.
Sitting on a branch, waiting for the wind.
Wings spread, at peace.
Drifting in the clouds, free.
Perched, waiting for the wind.
Relaxed, awaiting tomorrow.
Lightly perched, awaiting dawn.
Drifting through the sky, a wind walker.
Perched on a branch, awaiting dusk.

lines.zh: 单腿站着，把头埋进羽毛。
lines.en: It stands on one leg, head tucked into feathers.
It preens the down on its chest.
Noticing the player, curious gaze.
Staring at the player, will you follow?
Observing the player, will you travel together?
Noticing the player, will you follow?
Looking at the player, will you intersect?
Noticing the player, will we meet?
Observing the player, will we intersect?
Staring at the player, are we on the same path?
Observing the player, will we go together?
Head tilted, it studies your hands.

lines.zh: 闻到野菜的味道，凑了过来。
lines.en: It smells the greens and comes closer.
It walks a half circle around you.

lines.zh: 用喙轻轻碰了碰你的袖子。
lines.en: It nudges your sleeve with its beak.
It backs off two steps and looks back.
My wings are hurt! Hop on!

lines.zh: 快下来，我的翅膀受伤了！
lines.en: Get off! My wings are hurt!
Help! My wings are hurt!
My wings are hurt, help me!

lines.zh: 快骑上我，我的翅膀受伤了！
lines.en: Hop on, my wings are hurt!
My wings are hurt, hop on!
My wings are hurt, help!
My wings are hurt, help me!
My wings are hurt, save me!

lines.zh: 快救我，我的翅膀受伤了！
lines.en: Save me, my wings are hurt!

lines.zh: 咕咕咕，美食诱惑我飞行更高！
lines.en: Kukuku, food calls me to fly higher!

lines.zh: 咕咕咕，快给我喂点Gysahl Greens！
lines.en: Kukuku, give me some Gysahl Greens!

lines.zh: 咕咕咕，今天要试试那块蛋糕！
lines.en: Kukuku, today’s the day for that cake!

lines.zh: 咕咕咕，那边有什么好吃的？
lines.en: Kukuku, what’s over there?

lines.zh: 咕咕咕，来吧，一起享受美味！
lines.en: Kukuku, let’s enjoy the feast together!

lines.zh: 咕咕咕，这个方向有新鲜食物！
lines.en: Kukuku, fresh food this way!

lines.zh: 咕咕咕，我要去寻找美味果实！
lines.en: Kukuku, off to find some tasty fruits!

lines.zh: 咕咕咕，这些蘑菇看起来不错！
lines.en: Kukuku, those mushrooms look good!

lines.zh: 咕咕咕，森林深处有更多美味！
lines.en: Kukuku, more treats in the forest!
Kukuku, this fruit is so sweet!
Bam! Nearly hit a cliff!
Phew, almost hit the bushes!
Sss, watch out for the trap below!
Whoa, almost hit the lava!
Crash! Almost hit a vine!
Blink, watch the branches above!
Boom! Almost hit the rock wall!
Bang, on the tree trunk!
Snap, avoid that sharp stone!

lines.zh: 嗡嗡，我差点撞上蜘蛛网！
lines.en: Whizz, almost hit a spider web!
Kukuku, time to find a mate!
Kukuku, that’s a mate!
Kukuku, time for mating!
Kukuku, come on, let’s mate!

lines.zh: 咕咕咕，找到合适的伴侣！
lines.en: Kukuku, found a suitable mate!
Kukuku, mating successful!
Kukuku, looking for a mate!
Kukuku, mating begins!

lines.zh: 咕咕咕，这下子可以生小陆行鸟了！
lines.en: Kukuku, now we can have Chicobo!
Kukuku, laying eggs!
Hop on! I'm taking off!
Follow me, I'll fly with you!

lines.zh: 我吃基萨尔野菜，跑得像风。
lines.en: I eat Gysahl Greens and run like wind.
Let's go adventuring!
Ready, I'm accelerating!
Fly with me!
Come on, let's go!
Don't fall behind, I'm leading!
Hop on, let's go!
Follow me, safe place!
There it is, my food!

lines.zh: 基萨尔野菜也别想让我分心。
lines.en: Not even gysahl greens will distract me now.

lines.zh: 那是我的食物，必须捕获！
lines.en: That's my food, gotta catch!
Catch it now, quick!
Locked on, I'll eat it!
That's food, go get it!
Food found, capture it!

lines.zh: 那是我的猎物，我要吃了！
lines.en: That's my prey, I'll eat it!
Food target locked, moving in!

lines.zh: 猎物就在附近，快去捕获！
lines.en: Prey nearby, capture now!
Attacking, taking off!

lines.zh: 我的黄羽炸开，喙已经对准。
lines.en: My yellow feathers flare; my beak is aimed.

lines.zh: 我蹬地起步，追着你的味道。
lines.en: I kick off and chase your scent.
Target its weakness, attack!

lines.zh: 我这身黄羽，跑起来比风快。
lines.en: Yellow feathers; I run faster than wind.
Target its heart, attack!

lines.zh: 锁定目标，准备释放火焰！
lines.en: Locked on, releasing fire!
Target its belly, attack!

lines.zh: 我蹬起一腿沙，冲向你的侧面。
lines.en: I kick up sand and charge your flank.
Target its head, attack!

lines.zh: 发出低沉的咆哮，扇动翅膀攻击！
lines.en: Growls lowly, flaps wings to attack!

lines.zh: 快速扑向敌人，用爪子击打！
lines.en: Rushes at the enemy, striking with claws!

lines.zh: 挥动翅膀，对着你拍来拍去！
lines.en: Flaps wings, smacks you over and over!

lines.zh: 张开大嘴，咬向你的手臂！
lines.en: Opens big mouth, bites at your arm!

lines.zh: 用喙啄你，试图让你痛苦！
lines.en: Pecks at you, trying to cause pain!

lines.zh: 展开翅膀，对着你扇扇子！
lines.en: Spreads wings, fans you!

lines.zh: 扇动翅膀，准备进行攻击！
lines.en: Flaps wings, getting ready to attack!

lines.zh: 用翅膀拍打，试图击退你！
lines.en: Slaps with wings, trying to push you back!

lines.zh: 扑向你，用爪子攻击你的脸！
lines.en: Rushes at you, attacking your face with claws!

lines.zh: 用嘴啄你，试图啄出你的血！
lines.en: Pecks at you, trying to peck out your blood!

lines.zh: 发出咕咕声，从蛋中孵化出来！
lines.en: Gurgles, hatches from an egg!

lines.zh: 轻声咕咕叫，从蛋壳中出来！
lines.en: Gurgles softly, comes out of the eggshell!

lines.zh: 咕噜一声，从蛋里爬了出来！
lines.en: Grunts, crawls out of the egg!

lines.zh: 发出咕咕声，孵化出小陆行鸟！
lines.en: Gurgles, hatches into a Chicobo!

lines.zh: 咕噜一声，从蛋壳里冒出来！
lines.en: Grunts, pops out of the eggshell!

lines.zh: 轻轻咕咕叫，从蛋壳中孵化！
lines.en: Gurgles softly, hatches from the eggshell!

lines.zh: 咕噜一声，从蛋里孵化出来！
lines.en: Grunts, hatches from the egg!

lines.zh: 从蛋壳中发出咕咕声，孵化！
lines.en: Gurgles from the eggshell, hatches!

lines.zh: 咕噜一声，从蛋里孵出来！
lines.en: Grunts, hatches from the egg!

lines.zh: 咕咕声中孵化出小陆行鸟！
lines.en: Gurgles, hatches Chicobo!
A kweh sounds from the grass.

lines.zh: 它从树后蹦出来，抖了抖羽毛。
lines.en: It hops out from behind a tree and ruffles its feathers.
On fire! Hop on and escape!
Fallen! Hop on!
Drowning! Help!
Exploded! Hop on!
Hit by an arrow! Help!

lines.zh: 被魔法击中了，快骑上我！
lines.en: Hit by magic! Hop on!
Starving! Help!
Lightning hit me! Help!
Fell into the void! Help!
